They rely on the mobility of their small raiding parties and advanced anti-gravity skimmers to make up for their lack of heavy armor. Abandoned by their ruling class during the Robot Legion uprising, handfuls of the Elvish lower classes managed to escape into space. These surviving Elves formed gangs, ready to do whatever it takes to survive. Bitter and distrustful of outsiders, the Gangs persist, taking what they need from outsiders to ensure that they can never be betrayed again. The Elven Empire was once a dominant power within the Sirius Sector, possessing both advanced psychic abilities and highly advanced technology, and Elven society was strictly governed by a psychically... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/dark-elf-raiders) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Harassing: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee. ### Special Rules Agile: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2” when using Rush/Charge. Infiltrate: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit. Lacerate: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Martial Prowess: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being fatigued when activated for the second time). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round. Melee Evasion: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where all models have this rule. Melee Slayer: When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher. Piercing Frenzy: Place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two markers. For each marker all models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking until the end of the game. Precision Fighting Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once (next time the effect would apply). Regeneration Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply). Regenerative Strength: Place one marker on this model when it ignores a wound. When in melee, pick one of its weapons to get +X attacks, where X is the number of markers on it. Strafing: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way. Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Vanguard: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position. ### Aura Special Rules Courage Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Furious Aura: This model and its unit get Furious. Harassing Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Harassing Boost. Melee Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Piercing Hunter Aura: This model and its unit get Piercing Hunter. Read more ### Spells Psy-Adrenaline (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Harassing Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Snake Bite (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Lacerate. Raiding Drugs (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once (next time the effect would apply). Art of Pain (2): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 2 hits with AP(2) and Deadly(3). Fade in the Dark (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Stealth once (next time the effect would apply). Holistic Suffering (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 9 hits. ### Units ### Heroes Dark Lord [1] Qua 3+Def 4+ 55pts Elite Barb Pistol(12", A2, Lacerate), CCW(A2) Harassing, Hero,
